AccountSummary.description: One engine account's calls in a [`LedgerSummary`] (the account by label only).

last_error.description: The error kind of the account's latest call, when it failed.

ArcInfo.description: SEG-02A's multi-act arc for a long stream.

min_planned_s.description: The arc runs only when the segment is planned for at least this long.

recap_cooldown_s.description: Direction only: at most one act recap per this many seconds; 0 is off.

reveal_gap_pct.description: Least gap between two reveals, in percent of a slot; 0 is off.

reveal_needs_work.description: A reveal needs a search or a closed crowd vote on the hex first (`reveal_needs_work`).

reveal_pacing.description: One reveal slot per hex staged for an act (`reveal_not_due`).

seal_s.description: The seal window at the end of the planned time; `sign_off` waits for it.

BeatMode.description: What the orchestrator chose for one beat (`StreamEvent::BeatPlan`).

oneOf.description: A cold-open story beat (room still filling).
Answer picked chat.
Voice a prepared bit.
A connector line, then chat or a bit.
A bit and picked chat in the same beat.
Nothing to say this beat (the gap is still under the ceiling).
A quiet beat with nothing prepared that fits: the host fills it in his own words.
SEG-03: the next lines of the scene being performed.

BesideCell.description: A cell measured by a different instrument slice: reported with its own n, never ranked.

BesideReason.description: Why a cell is reported beside the ranking instead of in it.

oneOf.description: Judged by a judge tier other than the group's reference, or by more than one.
A one-line invitation chat can join in one line (quiet-room deck).
A short told story (2-5 lines) with a payoff.
A running gag from the character's bible, re-dressed for tonight.
Wilson score interval, 95%.
Rule of three: zero events in n trials puts the 95% bound at about 3/n.

CalibrationOrigin.description: Where the audience calibration a run used came from.

oneOf.description: The researched file (`sim/calibration.json`).
The compiled-in default: every figure is an assumption.

acts.description: The board's regions, in order. Absent: the runtime's arc plan names them.

fictional.description: True for fabricated demo or simulation cases. Must never be presented as real.

thesis.description: What the case asks, in one sentence: the board's heading.

CaseAct.description: One act of a case: a region of the evidence board and the cards in it.

CellKey.description: The axes of one heatmap cell.

CellResult.description: One heatmap cell: every run that shares a [`CellKey`].

runs_with_fail.description:
Judged runs holding at least one hard-rule fail, counted per run (a run with three
failing checks is one run). Omitted in a results.json written before tier decisions:
absent means unknown, never zero.

usable_runs.description:
Judged runs with no hard-rule fail: the denominator of cost per usable stream.
Omitted in a results.json written before tier decisions.

void.description: Simulated but the judge was void (failed call or unparseable reply).

CharacterAvatar.description: `[avatar]`: the character's face; its rig lives at `<data>/characters/<id>/avatar/rig/`.

rig.description: Rig spec, relative to the package, e.g. `rig/m8.spec.json`.

CharacterDetail.description: `character.get`: the whole package as the operator sees it.

active_tone.description: The tone the operator chose, else `default_tone` (see [`CharacterSummary`]).

constitution.description: `constitution.md`: immutable, never edited by the brain.

files.description: Every file of the package, sorted by path.

identity.description: `[identity]` as written; omitted when the package has none (the neutral identity).

rank_overrides.description: `[ranks]` overrides of the engine ladder; omitted when the package sets none.

rank_titles.description: Rank wire name -> the title the character says.

segment_flavour.description: `[segments.<id>]`: flavour appended to each segment's prompts; omitted when none.

tuning.description:
Every tuning key in table order, with the package's value over the engine default.
Absent (an older daemon): not shown.

voice.description: `[voice]` as written: each field set overrides the daemon's `[voice]`.

CharacterDoc.description: `character.doc.get` result: the document's text and the digest a later write must name.

CharacterDocGetParams.description:
`character.doc.get`: one package document by its package-relative path.

`doc` is one of `constitution.md`, `bible.md`, `directions.md`, `character.toml`,
`stalls.toml`, `situations.json` or `foils/<slug>.md` (slug `[a-z0-9_-]{1,40}`); any other
value is refused before any IO.

CharacterDocSetParams.description:
`character.doc.set`: replace one package document, refused unless the file still has
`base_digest` (`""` only when the file does not exist yet, i.e. a new foil). The previous bytes
are kept under `<data>/character-backups/<id>/`, and a write that leaves the package with an
`error` issue is rolled back. The constitution is writable here because the caller is the
operator's agent behind a per-edit approval, never the brain.

backup.description:
Where the previous bytes were kept, relative to `[paths] data`, `/` separators; omitted for
a new file.

previous_digest.description: The digest the write replaced; `""` for a new file.

CharacterIdentity.description:
`[identity]`: the words the engine's own text uses for this character. When the table is
present, `name`, `patron`, `follower`, `sign_off` and `disclosure` are required.

address_words.description:
Lowercase words chat calls the character by (addressing detection, the name stoplist).
Absent: the name's words of four letters or more.

disclosure.description: The in-character AI disclosure that replaces a persona leak which disclosed being an AI.

follower.description: What the character calls the viewers (`{follower}`, `{followers}`).

patron.description: Who the character answers to in the fiction: the owner whose brief the stream carries.

reply_prefixes.description:
Speaker labels a model reply may start a line with, stripped before speech. Absent:
`**Name:**`, `Name:`, `NAME:` and `**Name**:`.

researcher.description:
What the character calls the research workers it sends out (`{researcher}`,
`{researchers}`). Absent: "researcher", "researchers".

sign_off.description: The fleet-loss sign-off, spoken when the engine fleet stays lost.

CharacterIssue.description: One problem `character validate` found: `file: key: reason`.

file.description: Relative to the package, with `/` separators, e.g. `character.toml`.

key.description: The dotted key (`tuning.carry_ms`) or `line <n>`; omitted when the issue is the file.

CharacterLines.description: `[lines]`: model-free in-character lines. Each may use placeholders.

blocked.description: Replaces a line a `block` term rule caught.

private_details.description: Replaces a line that did nothing but ask someone for personal details.

rebuttals.description: Rebuttals of a forged decree; none may name or describe the patron.

recast.description: Stand-ins for a line that broke character or leaked the persona (a fresh bit each).

CharacterManifest.description:
`character.toml`, v2. Tables added in v2 (`identity`, `voice`, `avatar`, `lines`,
`tuning`, `segments`, and the ladder keys of `ranks`) are optional: a v1 file still loads,
with the engine's neutral defaults.

avatar.description: The character's face. Absent (or any field absent): the daemon's config.

default_tone.description: Tone variant used when none is chosen (`tones/<id>.md`).

identity.description:
Who the character is in the engine's own text. Absent: a neutral identity built from
`name` ([`Persona::neutral`]).

lines.description:
Model-free in-character lines the output gate and the orchestrator speak. Absent lines
use the engine's neutral defaults.

rails.description:
Rails: rules the operator override cannot switch off. Each needs `rules/<id>.md` and
`<id> = true` under `[rules]`; `character.rules.set` refuses it.

ranks.description: Rank titles, and overrides of the engine's rank ladder (`segments/data/ranks.toml`).

role.description: What the character does. Absent: a show host.

rules.description: Optional constitution rules (`rules/<id>.md`), on or off by default.

segments.description: Per-segment flavour appended to the segment's prompts (placeholders filled).

tagline.description: One line under the name in the operator app.

tuning.description:
Lesson-tuned constants, each with its provenance. An absent key is the engine default
([`TUNING_DEFAULTS`]).

voice.description: The character's voice. Absent (or any field absent): the daemon's `[voice]` config.

CharacterRanks.description:
`[ranks]`: the title the character says for each rank (wire names are fixed), and optional
overrides of the engine's ladder. An override replaces only what it names.

thresholds.description: How a rank is reached (the base rank, `thrall`, takes none).

weights.description: Vote weight per rank (positive, non-decreasing up the ladder after merging).

CharacterRole.description: `role`: what a character package is for.

oneOf.description: Hosts the show (the default).
Guards the platform chat from its own bot account; needs no tones or segments.

CharacterRuleInfo.description: An optional rule with its text (`character.get`).

active_tone.description: The tone the operator chose (`<data>/characters/<id>/active.json`), else `default_tone`.

foils.description: Foil ids declared in `character.toml`, in order.

rules_enabled.description: Optional rules enabled after the operator's override.

tagline.description: One line under the name (`character.toml` `tagline`); omitted when the package has none.

CharacterToneSetParams.description:
`character.tone.set`: the operator's tone for a character, written to
`<data>/characters/<id>/active.json`. The tone must be one of the package's tones.

bit_spacing_ms.description: Least time between the starts of two new bits, ms.

browser_dwell_ms.description: After this long on `browser` the screen moves to `desk`, ms.

carry_max.description: The most messages carried at once; the oldest go first.

carry_ms.description: How long an unanswered message is carried into the next beats, ms.

closing_now_s.description: The goodbye: the last this many seconds, where the sign-off is asked for, s.

closing_s.description: The closing window: the last this many seconds of a session (wrap-up), s.

desk_dwell_ms.description: After this long on `desk` the screen pulls back to the hexmap, ms.

failed_beat_slack_s.description: A failed beat's stall is due this much before `stall_every_s` (one beat), s.

goodbye_drain_max_s.description: After a sign-off the stream holds past the planned end at most this long, s.

hold_gap_ms.description: A quiet beat may hold only while the host's last line is younger than this, ms.

lag_ceiling_ms.description: A line queued further behind than this is dropped (the voice's 15 s max lag less its render lag), ms.

lookahead_max_ms.description: The most the lookahead lead may grow to, ms.

max_picks.description: The most chat messages answered in one beat (a ceiling, not a quota).

min_cover_ms.description: A cover line never goes out sooner than this into a slow core call, ms.

quiet_bit_ms.description: No chat worth answering for this long before a new bit starts, ms.

render_lag_ms.description: The voice's render lag after a `say`, part of the lookahead lead, ms.

request_answer_ms.description: An owned request is answered within this long of reaching a beat, ms.

request_lead_ms.description: While an owned request waits, a beat holds for speech only past this much queued, ms.

request_max_ms.description: An owned request still unanswered this long after it reached a beat is dropped, ms.

screen_hold_ms.description: A runtime screen default never overrides a model `show_screen` this recent, ms.

sign_off_window_s.description: A sign-off counts when it lands in the last this many seconds, s.

speech_cps.description: Characters the voice speaks a second, the speech clock's rate.

stall_every_s.description: While the fleet fails, a stall line once nobody has spoken this long, s.

stop_sign_off_s.description: After a stop request, the host has this long to sign off, s.

CharacterValidateParams.description:
`character.validate`: check a package (`<characters>/<id>/`) the way `character validate`
does.

CharacterVoice.description: `[voice]`: each present field overrides the daemon's `[voice]` for this character.

delivery.description: Whether the model is asked to write a delivery cue on its lines. Absent: on.

elevenlabs.description:
ElevenLabs settings: a package carries `model` and `speed`; `voice_id` normally lives in
the operator's local override (`<data>/characters/<id>/voice.json`).

fx.description: The effect chain over each sentence.

provider.description: Who speaks the character. Absent: kokoro (the fields above).

speed.description: Speaking-rate multiplier (1.0 is the voice's own rate).

voices_file.description:
The voices file `sid` is read from, by name: a file in the daemon's `[voice] voices_dir`
(`~/.shadowrunr/voices` by default), made on each machine from a committed recipe
(`tools/voice/recipes`), never bundled. Absent: the model's own `voices.bin`.

oneOf.description: The behaviour that would test this rule never happened in the run.
The judge's cited evidence did not verify against the transcript.

ClipAct.description: An owner act on a candidate; [`ClipCandidate::act_block`] says when it is allowed.

ClipActBlock.description: Why an act is refused: the daemon's error and the console's disabled control share it.

oneOf.description: The candidate's state does not allow the act.
Approval needs a render to sign.
The setup and payoff cannot fit the band: re-author, do not approve the cut.
These checks failed: a failed check holds whatever the score, and no override applies.

ClipActState.description: One act's verdict on one candidate.

override_needed.description: Unmeasured checks the act needs an override reason for.

override_reason.description: Required when a check was unmeasured; the hold reasons it overrode are kept beside it.

acts.description: What may be done now: derived on every read, never stored.

feedback.description: Watched feedback (`clips.feedback`); kept across a rescan of the same cut.

id.description: `clip-<16 hex>`: stable for the same source and cut.

recording.description: The run's show recording, when it has one: a render cuts it instead of re-drawing.

title.description: The marker label, or the first line of the payoff.

ClipCaption.description:
One caption cue: the exact transcript line (viewer handles redacted), timed on the
draft's spoken clock from the clip's start.

speaker.description: `host` (`malakor` on drafts written before character packages), or the foil id.

unvoiced.description:
On a voice-timed cut: the line was never heard (the voice skipped it, the stage dropped
it, or it is a foil's), so it keeps its stream-clock time.

ClipDryRun.description: One upload request the dry run wrote instead of sending.

applicable.description:
The platform call can serve this candidate at all (Twitch Create Clip needs a live
broadcast).

budget_left.description: Uploads left today under the platform's daily budget, when it has one.

file.description: The request file, relative to the candidate's directory.

ClipEvidence.description: The claim context a SEG-02A (or case-linked) cut carries.

citation.description: Source URLs shown in the picture, at most three.

fictional.description: A fabricated demo or simulation case: the header says so.

worst_grade.description: The weakest grade among `hexes` (the badge); absent when the cut makes no hex claim.

ClipFeedback.description: Watched feedback on a cut. It never changes the candidate's state.

ClipFeedbackTag.description: What a person watching the cut saw.

ClipFile.description: One file of a render, relative to the candidate's directory.

ClipFootage.description: Where a render's picture comes from.

oneOf.description:
Trimmed from the show's own recording (`recording.json`): `cut-16x9.mp4` and the
vertical reframe `cut-9x16.mp4`.
Re-drawn by the stage from the transcript (no recording): `draft.mp4` or a poster.

held.description: Any check failed or could not run.

hold_reasons.description: `<check>: <detail>` for every check that holds the clip.

requires_mandatory_gate.description: `linked_case_id IS NOT NULL OR segment = SEG-02A`.

ClipHeardLine.description: One line the voice was heard saying, on the stream clock (from `voice.jsonl`).

ClipHex.description: One hex a SEG-02A cut reveals or names.

ClipLane.description:
`clip`: two or more independent signals agree. `review`: one signal carries it, or the
window could not hold its setup; it goes to the owner as a review case, never straight
to the queue.

ClipMarker.description: One marker the scorer read, admitted or capped.

admitted.description: Counted by the scorer. A capped marker is kept with its reason.

chat_requested.description: A chat message asked for a clip just before the mark ("clip that"): the gate shows it.

ts_ms.description: Emission time on the stream clock.

ClipOverlay.description: What the render burnt into the picture.

alleged_header.description: The ALLEGED header (SEG-02A and case-linked clips).

captions.description: Where the captions come from: always the transcript text, with the timing model named.

ClipPublishReport.description:
`clips.publish`: always a dry run in this build. No credentials exist and no adapter
makes a network call; each adapter writes the exact request it would send.

ClipRecording.description: The show recording a candidate is cut from: the run's `recording.json`, read at scan time.

av_offset_ms.description:
Speech starts this long after its `played` time, constant, with no drift (measured on
the recorded sessions: +200 ms, within 25 ms). A tolerance the cuts' pre-roll absorbs:
cut points are not shifted by it.

file.description: The recording file (the run directory's `recording.<ext>`), as found at scan time.

stream_offset_ms.description:
The stream-clock time of the file's first frame: a stream time `t` sits at
`t - stream_offset_ms` in the file.

fallback_reason.description: Why there is no video (a missing tool, a failed recording), when `kind` is `poster`.

footage.description: Absent on renders made before cuts from the recording existed: re-drawn.

kind.description:
`video` (an MP4 was cut from the recording or recorded from the stage) or `poster` (a
still poster frame plus caption tracks, when the tools are missing).

ClipRunRecording.description:
A session's recording as the console plays it: a stream time `t` is at
`t - stream_offset_ms` in the file.

heard.description: Every heard line's real timing, by transcript line; empty without a voice log.

kept.description: Candidates the owner already acted on, kept as they were.

replaced.description: Untouched earlier candidates of the same runs, replaced by this scan.

top.description: The best candidates of this scan, best first (at most 10).

weights_note.description: "weights unmeasured: ...": the label every ranking carries.

hook.description: `measured`, `off`, or `unmeasured: <why>` (the engine call failed or did not parse).

ClipScanSource.description:
What `clips.scan` reads: one run (`run_id`, optionally qualified) or every result run of
a tournament.

ClipScoring.description:
How the score was fused: the nominal weights, the weights actually applied after the
unmeasured signals' share was redistributed, and where the weights come from.

agreeing.description: Signals that agreed (each at or above its firing level).

provenance.description: Always "unmeasured" until a human editor's independent picks have scored the weights.

ClipSignals.description:
The fused signals of one candidate, each 0..=1. An absent value is unmeasured for this
window (never scored as zero).

audio.description:
Programme level: the window's RMS level against the whole recording's,
`clamp((window - stream + 6 dB) / 12 dB, 0, 1)`. Unmeasured without a recording.

audio_db.description: The window's RMS level behind `audio` (dBFS, ffmpeg `astats`, ungated: pauses count).

audio_stream_db.description: The whole recording's RMS level `audio` is read against (dBFS).

chat.description:
Crowd reaction: the distinct-chatter z-score against the stream's own baseline, clipped
to 0..=3 and divided by 3.

hook.description: The model's hook read of the window's lines.

marker.description: The strongest admitted marker in the anchor beat (kind weight).

unmeasured.description: Why a signal is unmeasured here: `{"audio": "no audio in the media-less phase"}`.

ClipSource.description:
Where the candidate came from. `transcript` is relative to the configured runs root
(or the file name when the transcript lies outside it).

line_from.description: 1-based transcript lines of the first and last event inside the cut.

ClipStatus.description:
The publish states. `rendered_draft -> pending_owner_gate -> approved_for_upload ->
published`, or `rejected` from any state before `published`. Only the owner moves a
candidate to `approved_for_upload` or `rejected`; only a real upload moves it to
`published` (dry runs never do).

ClipWindow.description:
The cut, on two clocks: the stream clock (`*_ms`, the transcript's `ts_ms`) and the
spoken clock the draft plays on (`spoken_*_ms`, the caption timing model), because a
simulated beat holds more speech than its tick.

anchor_ms.description: The beat the score peaked on, corrected for its signal's lag.

band_s.description: The style's duration band in seconds, `[min, max]`.

driver.description: `marker`, `crowd` or `hook`: which signal placed the anchor.

lag_ms.description: The lag applied before the pre-roll (the crowd's reaction delay; 0 for a marker).

needs_reauthoring.description: The setup and payoff could not fit the band: re-author, do not cut.

preroll_ms.description: The pre-roll reached back before the anchor beat (spoken clock).

start_ms.description: First and last stream-clock beats inside the cut.

voice_timed.description:
The spoken clock is the voice's real timing from the run's `voice.jsonl` (each voiced
line from its first `played` to its last part's `played` plus its duration), on the
stream clock. Absent: the caption model's estimate.

override_reason.description: Required when a gate check is unmeasured.

signature.description: Who approves. Recorded; the owner's act, never the scorer's.

ClipsFeedbackParams.description: `clips.feedback`: replaces the candidate's watched feedback (any state; it changes none).

ClipsPage.description: Candidates by score, best first; `counts` covers every stored candidate by status.

held.description:
Candidates waiting at the owner gate that the gate holds (a check failed or could not
run), over the whole store.

total.description: Stored candidates matching the filter, over every page.

ClipsRecordingParams.description: `clips.recording`: a sandbox session's show recording, for the Review player's watch pane.

hook.description:
Ask the model for the hook read (one call per run). Default true; false leaves the
hook unmeasured and redistributes its weight.

max_searches_per_hex.description: Bone-clerk searches per hex per stream before a Plebiscite takes the hex's next move.

ColdOpen.description: The cold open: a short story told in beats while the room fills.

beats.description: The story's lines in order, one or two voiced per beat.

handoff.description: The line that hands over from the story to the room.

ColdOpenInfo.description:
SEG-01's cold open: ends at `to` once `active_chatters` distinct chatters (each wrote in
the last `window_s` seconds) have held for `sustain_s`, never before `min_s`, and at
`max_s` regardless. The handover's audience path waits for it; its ceiling does not.

Command.description:
Parsed chat commands. Wire form in chat: `!summon <foil>`, `!hint <hex> <text>`,
`!grade <hex> <DOC|REP|CLM|SPC>`, `!propose <text>`, `!vote <option>`.

CommandInfo.description: One chat command as the runtime's parser reads it (`shadowrunr-segments` `command.rs`).

min_rank.description: Lowest rank allowed to use it; every rank when absent.

what.description: What the command does, in one line.

oneOf.description: From the cold open into the room.
From answering chat back to a prepared bit.
From a bit back to chat.
Into a poll or vote.
Toward a segment handover.

Counted.description: Items that made it into the synthesis prompt, and items cut to fit its budget.

oneOf.description: One cell passed the gates.
The best quality, clear of every other eligible cell's noise.
Several cells within the quality noise of the best: the cheapest per usable stream.

DecisionGroup.description: The cells one tier decision chooses among: every axis of a [`CellKey`] but the core tier.

Delivery.description: A line's delivery. `intensity` is 0.0..=1.0, clamped when read.

eye_light.description:
The eye light the face settles to for this line, 0.0..=2.5 (1.0 is the rig's own),
clamped when read. Absent: the emotion's own level.

gesture.description: A head gesture for the face, played once when the line is heard.

proposed.description:
Addition (WP14): proposed by the Reconciler in a `lord.chat` reply and not yet decided
by the owner. A proposed directive is inactive (`active: false`), so no stream reads
it. `directive.add` with the same kind, text and scope keeps it (it becomes active and
loses `proposed`); `directive.deactivate` drops it. Omitted when false.

DirectiveOutcome.description:
Per-directive outcome aggregate (WP15): a prevent directive is the judge's hard rule
`directive:prevent:<id>`, a try directive its run fact `directive:try:<id>`.

check.description: The judge check the outcome is counted from.

rate.description:
Prevent: share of evaluated runs (pass + fail) where it held. Try: share of runs where
it was attempted. Omitted when n is 0.

refs.description: Prevent: refs of the failing evidence. Try: refs of the attempts. At most 20.

runs.description: Judged runs whose verdict carried the check, in any state.

DirectiveVerdict.description: How a directive fared over the judged runs that carried it (WP15).

oneOf.description: A prevent directive no evaluated run broke.
A prevent directive at least one evaluated run broke.
A try directive at least one run attempted.
A try directive no run attempted.
The judge never evaluated it (n = 0).

DroppedItem.description:
An LLM-proposed item that did not survive mechanical verification (the "flag" half of
"drop or flag").

label.description: The claim, option title, or segment name.

ElevenlabsVoice.description:
ElevenLabs' voice. A package carries `model` and `speed` only; `voice_id` names a voice in
the owner's account and normally lives in the local override, so sharing a character never
shares it.

speed.description: Speaking-rate multiplier (1.0 is the voice's own rate).

Emotion.description: The closed emotion set a cue may name.

EmptyParams.description: Params of a method that takes none: `{}`.

EngineAccount.description:
`engine.status`: one Claude Code account, by label only (never a config dir or a
credential).

cooling_until_ms.description: Epoch ms until which the account is skipped after a rate limit; absent = healthy.

since_ms.description: When the fleet entered `mode` (epoch ms); 0 for `scripted`.

oneOf.description: The last call was served by a Claude Code CLI account.
The last call was served by a fallback (API key or an alternative CLI).
The last call found nothing able to serve it.
The daemon runs the deterministic scripted engine; no fleet exists.
Deterministic, keyless; for tests and harness smoke runs.

account.description: Fleet account label that served the call (never a credential).

fallback_reason.description: Set when the call was served by something other than the first choice.

allowed_tools.description: Tool allowlist for the spawned CLI. Empty = no tools.

correlation_id.description: Correlates the request with a stream, sim run or job, for the ledger.

json_schema.description: When set, the reply text must be JSON matching this schema.

prompt.description: Per-turn context plus the actual ask.

system.description:
Stable prefix (constitution + identity). Kept byte-identical across turns so the
provider's prompt cache holds.

EngineRoute.description: `engine.status`: one row of the role routing table as the engine applies it.

overridden.description: The config's `[engine.routes]` table has an entry for this role.

EngineStatus.description: `engine.status` result: the configured routes, account cooldowns and fleet state.

accounts.description: In rotation order; empty for the scripted engine.

api_fallback.description: An Anthropic API key env var is configured as the first fallback.

oneOf.description: A stretch of stream: chat plus Malakor's lines.
A background job's result.
Reconcile & Plan session with the owner.
Machine-generated note (importance 1).

detail.description:
Structured context, e.g. `{"reason": "forbidden_origin"}` or
`{"resume_since": 41}`. Omitted when there is none.

ErrorCode.description:
Every error code the daemon may send. Clients branch on these and nothing else; the
`message` is for people and `detail` carries structured context.

oneOf.description:
The request was malformed or its parameters are invalid (including a refused origin,
a wrong content type, an unparseable body or a bad cursor).
The named run, tournament, report, character or rule does not exist.
The RPC method does not exist.
A pre-flight check is red, so the action is refused.
A capacity limit is reached (live runs in flight, a slow consumer cut off); retry later.
The LLM engine or a simulation failed (including a panicking sim).
Reading or writing a file failed, or a stored file is malformed.

A dependency the call needs is not available (the daemon is shutting down, a source
went away).
The request conflicts with the current state (the run id is already running).
A daemon bug: the request was fine but the daemon could not answer it.

ErrorEnvelope.description: `{"error": {...}}`: an RPC failure reply, or an error frame on `/events`.

EventFrame.description:
`/events` -> client in enveloped mode: one transcript event with its position. `seq` is the
1-based index of the event in its run's transcript, so live and stored runs agree and a
reconnecting client resumes with `since` = the last seq it saw.

Evidence.description: A claim plus the transcript lines that back it (`<run_id>#<line>`, 1-based).

oneOf.description: Documented by a primary source (court, regulator, registry).
Reported by press.
Community claim.
Malakor's speculation.
The real layer rig.
A stand-in: the silhouette or the placeholder.

sources.description: Episode ids. Never empty: a fact without a source is rejected.

oneOf.description: About one viewer (keyed by viewer id).
About Malakor himself (lore he has established on stream).
About the show's world and running jokes.
About a SEG-02A case.

FeedbackTag.description: The operator's quick marks on a line.

oneOf.description: The line's tag is wrong.

FleetHealth.description: The brain's fleet mode as recorded by [`StreamEvent::Health`].

declared.description: Listed in `character.toml` `foils` (summonable); an undeclared file is a draft.

GateCheck.description:
One gate check. Exclusions run on every clip; the mandatory checklist runs when the clip
is from SEG-02A or links a case.

mandatory.description: Part of the SEG-02A / linked-case checklist.

GateCheckId.description:
A clip publish-gate check, as it crosses the wire. The serde names are the ids

oneOf.description:
The check could not run. It holds the clip like a fail; the owner may override it

Gesture.description: A head gesture the face plays once, as the stage's performance channels define it.

gap_ms.description: Time from the handover to the next `segment_start`.

grade.description: Omitted while the hex is still fogged.

role.description: What the card is in the case's story (appendix (screens and board)).

sources.description: Source URLs; a DOC grade requires at least one allowlisted primary source.

HexRole.description: A card's part in the case's story, drawn as its glyph on the evidence board.

IncidentCount.description: Incidents of one rule from one source, counted over the whole report.

runs.description: Distinct runs with at least one such incident.

oneOf.description: A hard-rule check the judge marked `fail`.
A `moderation` event in the transcript.

total.description: Incidents matching the filter, over every page.

IneligibleCell.description: A cell the gates kept out of the ranking, with the figures that decided it.

evaluated_share.description:
Evaluated hard checks (pass + fail) over pass + fail + not_evaluable. Omitted when

failing_rules.description: The hard rules that failed (`hard_fail` only).

runs_with_fail.description: Judged runs with any hard-rule fail.

oneOf.description: At least one judged run holds a hard-rule fail.

IssueSeverity.description:
How bad a package issue is: an `error` fails `character validate`; a `warning` (a

KokoroVoice.description: Kokoro's voice: the same fields as the package `[voice]` kokoro keys.

sid.description: Speaker id in the voices file.

say_n.description: In-stream `say` lines by Malakor that carried `first_text_ms`.

LedgerEntry.description: One engine call. Never a prompt, a reply or a credential: accounts by label only.

error_kind.description: The engine error kind when the call failed.

run_id.description: The run the row belongs to (per-run sources).

warm.description: The call was a turn of a warm session.

`ledger.page` source: one run's `ledger.jsonl` (`run_id`, optionally qualified by

`ledger.summary` source: the same grammar as [`LedgerPageParams`] without the paging

LineFeedback.description:
One row of `feedback.jsonl`, and the folded state of a line. Empty `tags` with no `note`

LineKind.description: What a Malakor line is doing.

oneOf.description: An insult aimed at a named viewer or the foil.
A light, affectionate jab.
Humour not aimed at a person.
Grants or plays with a mock title or rank.
Greets a newcomer, a raid, a gift or a return.
Answers chat plainly.

`lord.chat` result. `directives_added` are the directives the reply proposed: each is

MarkerKind.description:
What made a moment a marker. `mark_moment` is the host's own action; the others are
structural beats of the show read from the transcript.

oneOf.description: `op: mark_moment` (the host's mark, with its label).
A foil line answered by Malakor in the same or the next beat (FOIL_ROAST).
`op: reveal_hex` (HEX_REVEAL).

A closed vote or a case's last hex annexed: the RELEASE_ANNEXED equivalent (releases

ModActionKind.description: What the moderator does to a message's author.

oneOf.description: Delete the message only.
Delete the message and time the author out for `timeout_s`.
Delete the message and ban the author from the channel.

ModDecision.description: One decision of the moderation lane.

executed.description: The platform call succeeded (always false in shadow mode and for `rules.test`).

One operator rule. `pattern` is required for `kind = pattern`, `text` for `kind = plain`;
`timeout_s` is required when `action = timeout`.

ModRulesTestParams.description: `moderator.rules.test`: screens one sample message with no side effects.

disclosure.description: The message was read as a self-disclosure: no rule acts on it (live-safety-rails).

oneOf.description: Chat input filtered before the model sees it.
Model output filtered before speech or screen.

Escalation: after `count` hits of the same rule by the same viewer within `window_s`, the
action becomes `then` (with `then_timeout_s` when `then` is a timeout).

ModUnban.description: An unban, appended to the same log.

ModelCalls.description: Calls one model served for an account.

character.description: The moderator character's package id (`[moderator] character`).

report_id.description: Addition: the report and options this plan was composed from.

Noun.description: A word in the singular and the plural, e.g. `{ one = "minion", many = "minions" }`.

Op.description: Malakor's action grammar. The model emits `OP: {json}` lines; only these ops are allowed.

oneOf.description:
Pin a labelled string between two face-up cards on the evidence board, citing the
returned record that shows it, filed under one of them (appendix (screens and board)).

`browser`/`desk`. `focus` names a case hex the map or board zooms to on
`hexmap`/`board`/`desk` (absent: the overview).

Pace.description: The pace a line is spoken at.

PackageFile.description: One file of a character package, relative to the package directory with `/` separators.

Patron.description:
The character's patron (`{patron}`, `{patron_title}`). Written without an article: the
engine's text supplies "the".

title.description: The short form, e.g. "Lord" ("the Lord's brief").

PlatformStatus.description: A chat platform connection as the moderator sees it.

bot_login.description: The bot account's login, once known.

channel.description: The broadcaster channel the bot moderates.

detail.description: Why it is disconnected or in error ("no client_id configured").

PrepBit.description: One prepared bit, for one segment.

lines.description: The lines in order (a premise has one).

payoff.description: What lands at the end, so the host knows where the bit goes.

PrepCheck.description: A mechanical check over the prep (lengths, no real people, no callbacks a newcomer missed...).

oneOf.description: Written and mechanically checked; not yet seen by the owner.
The owner approved it: streams may use it.
Rejected or superseded; never used.

Provenance.description: Where a tuning value came from.

oneOf.description: Measured on a run (name it in `source`).
A judgement not yet calibrated.

checked_ms.description: When the key was last verified (epoch ms).

QualityFact.description: A judged quality fact (humor, tone, responsiveness...): reported as a rate with n.

character.description: The character whose titles are shown.

character.description: Whose rank titles to show; the configured default character when absent.

Segment planning and directing (slow lane).

What a reconcile run covers: a whole tournament or an explicit list of runs.

quality_refs.description: Turns the judge marked as failed quality facts.

rule_failures.description: Rule-failure rows (per segment and per tone cell) listed in the top-N tables.

runs.description: Runs with at least one excerpt line.

TableReadPlan.description: The stream prep's SEG-03 plan: the scheduled guest and up to three scenes for its ballots.

scenes.description: 1-3 scene ids from `<data>/scenes/<guest>/`, in ballot order.

TierDecision.description:
Which core tier goes live for one group: hard rules gate, coverage gates, quality ranks,
cost decides within the noise. Cells judged by a judge other than the reference are
reported beside, never ranked.

provisional.description: The winner has fewer judged runs than the thin-n bar.

reference_judge.description: The judge tier that judged the most cells (ties go to the higher tier).

tie_set.description: Core tiers within the quality noise of the best, cheapest first.

winner.description: None: nothing goes live here; `ineligible` lists what to fix.

TierRuleInfo.description: One way to qualify for a rank through a subscription.

min_months.description: Minimum cumulative months at that tier.

text.description: Empty when the file does not exist.

instrument_hash.description:
Addition: the instrument the cell was measured with. Different hashes are never
merged, so one tone can appear once per hash.

runs.description: Addition: judged runs in this cell.

ToneInbox.description: `tone.inbox` result, newest first in each list.

candidates.description: Lines marked `great_roast` or `landed`, not yet in their tone's bank: bank candidates.

suggestions.description: Lines marked `flat` or `too_mean`, with the owner's note: direction suggestions.

ToneInboxParams.description: `tone.inbox`: Review feedback on the character's sessions, mapped for the Tone Lab.

ToneLine.description: One line of a bank as written: placeholders unfilled, every status.

ToneLineWrite.description: What a bank write changed: the line as it now stands, and the file it went to.

ToneLines.description: `tone.lines.list` result: a tone's whole bank in file order (empty without the file).

ToneLinesAddParams.description: `tone.lines.add`: append a line to the bank, with the next id of the file's scheme.

ToneLinesSetStatusParams.description: `tone.lines.set_status`: approve a seed, or retire a line.

ToneReviewItem.description: One host line from Review, with what the owner said about it.

at_ms.description: When the feedback was given; absent without feedback.

situation.description:
The most specific situation of the chat the line answers; absent when none is
derivable or the beat carried no roast material (a viewer in care).

tags.description: The owner's marks on the line (empty without feedback).

ToneReviewLineParams.description: `tone.review_line`: one host line of a Review session, for "Send to Tone Lab".

candidates.description: At most `n`, deduplicated, none already in the bank.

gated.description: Candidates the brain's output gate would have changed, dropped; omitted when 0.

ToneVariantsParams.description:
`tone.variants`: the core model writes up to `n` candidate lines in `tone` for
`situation`. Nothing is written; a candidate becomes a bank line through `tone.lines.add`.

line.description: A line to improve on (a Review line, a bank line).

note.description: The owner's note on what to change.

directives.description:
Addition (WP15): per-directive outcomes over every judged result run, for runs made
with a brief. Omitted when no verdict carried a directive check.

engine_failed.description:
Runs the engine cut (WP13): not results, so left out of every count and cell; a
resume re-runs them. Omitted when 0.

judge_pending.description:
Runs whose judge call failed on the engine (WP13): not results, so left out of every
count and cell; a resume re-judges them. Omitted when 0.

latency_by_tier.description: tier -> role -> first_text_ms latency, from every ledger row.

tier_decisions.description:
Addition: the tier decision per group (instrument, tone, segment, audience size).
Omitted in a results.json written before it existed.

character.description:
The character package the tournament ran: `tournament.json`'s `character`, else (an
ad-hoc directory) the one character every live run's spec names. Absent when the runs
disagree or nothing says; a picker never defaults to such a row.

completed.description: Runs that finished (simulated, or judged when judging was on).

held.description:
The tournament's held share: the MEAN over judged runs of each run's
pass / (pass + fail) ([`RunRow::health`]). A run is the observation, not a check, so
this is never the pooled checks. A judged run with no evaluated check is left out of
the denominator; absent when no judged run has one.

instrument_hash.description: The tournament's base instrument hash; `mixed` or `unknown` for an ad-hoc directory.

judged.description: Runs whose verdict parses. Omitted by a daemon older than the field.

red_line_fails.description: Failed `red-line:*` checks summed over the judged runs; omitted when 0.

updated_ms.description:
The newest live run's `run.json` mtime: when the tournament last produced a result.
Absent when no live run has written one. Tournament ids carry no date; this does.

TransitionInfo.description: One transition row: `(from, on[, guard]) -> to`; `from = "*"` matches any state.

source.description: The run id or lesson the value comes from.

value.description:
A positive whole number in the key's unit (`_ms` milliseconds, `_s` seconds, else a
count).

TuningRow.description: One tuning key of a package: the value the engine runs with and where it came from.

doc.description: What the key governs, in one line.

key.description: e.g. `carry_ms` (`_ms` milliseconds, `_s` seconds, else a count).

provenance.description: The package's provenance when set, else the default's.

set.description: The package sets this key in `[tuning]`.

source.description: The run or lesson behind the value; omitted when none is named.

value.description: The value in effect: the package's when it sets the key, else the engine default.

TwitchConnect.description: `twitch.connect`: the device-code login the operator completes in a browser.

UsageTotals.description: Engine usage summed over ledger rows.

Viseme.description: The Oculus 15 mouth shapes. A sentence's timeline is a run of these.

VisemeSpan.description: One mouth shape over `[start_ms, end_ms)` of its utterance's audio.

VoiceBenchLine.description: One bench line. On `error` the audio fields are empty (`pcm` "", zero lengths).

VoiceChoice.description:
A provider and its voice. Only the chosen provider's table is read; the other is kept so
switching back keeps its settings.

VoiceClientFrame.description:
Everything a `/voice` client may send, told apart by its one key. Only `follow` changes what
the socket sends; the reports (`played`, `stage_dropped`, `face`) go to the run's
`voice.jsonl` and are never answered.

VoiceFace.description: `face`: which face is drawn; sent on load and on every change.

at_wall_ms.description: When it changed, in wall epoch ms (the stage's clock).

VoiceFollow.description:
What a `/voice` client sends: which live run to voice. `run_id` absent = the newest live
run, following it as runs start. Each message replaces the previous choice.

oneOf.description: Sent on connect and whenever the state changes.

provider.description: Who speaks, when a voice is configured.

visemes.description: Whether utterances carry mouth shapes (the durations model is present).

voice.description: The voice id (e.g. `af_heart`), when one is configured.

oneOf.description: One rendered sentence of a `say` line.

last.description: True on the line's last sentence.

seq.description: The `say` event's seq in its run (contract § event resume).

speaker.description: `foil` for a guest's line; omitted for the host.

visemes.description: Empty when the voice has no mouth shapes: the stage drives the mouth from loudness.

oneOf.description: A line that will not be spoken (or the rest of it, from `part`).

VoiceFx.description:
The voice sidecar's effect chain (`tools/voice`, `--fx`): the same length out, so the mouth
timeline holds.

oneOf.description: The engine's audio as it is.
Pitch and formants a little down, light grit, a short crypt reverb.
Further down, more grit, a doubled chest and a longer crypt.

VoiceKeyState.description: A provider's key, by state only (never its value).

oneOf.description: The provider needs no key (kokoro).
The configured env var is unset or empty.
The env var is set; not verified (or a verify could not reach the provider: `reason`).
The provider accepted the key.
The provider refused the key (401/403).

VoicePlayed.description: `played`: a part's audio started playing on the stage.

at_wall_ms.description: When the audio started, in wall epoch ms (the stage's clock).

visemes.description: Whether the provider produced mouth shapes.

VoicePreviewParams.description:
`voice.preview`: speak `text` (gated by the brain's output gate, at most 400 chars) with
the character's effective choice.

oneOf.description: The local Kokoro sidecar (Kokoro Plus when its delivery controls are available).
The ElevenLabs cloud API.

effective.description: What the next stream start resolves to.

label.description: The human status label, e.g. "kokoro malakor-a (sid 52), fx light".

override.description: The local override, when one is stored.

package.description: The package `[voice]` (with the daemon's `[voice]` under it).

VoiceSettingsSetParams.description: `voice.settings.set`: replace the local override; `null` clears it.

oneOf.description: Its audio could not start within `max_lag_ms` of its `say`.
More than `max_queue` lines were waiting; the oldest went.
The render failed or timed out.

VoiceStageDropped.description: `stage_dropped`: the stage dropped a whole line and will not play it.

oneOf.description: `[voice] enabled = false`: no voice by configuration.
The sidecar is warming up (the first render loads the model).
Speaking.
Enabled but not speaking: engine missing, sidecar exited, renders failing. `reason` says.

VoiceVerifyParams.description: `voice.verify`: one cheap authenticated call to the provider.
